'''Karatha''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was the location of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Eyrie Base|base]], which was situated in a natural [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]].

==Description==
{{Quote|You're gonna love it. Warm and sunny. And we have our very own beach.|[[Stevan Makintay]], to [[Ketrian Altronel]]|<ref name="JC8" />}}
Karatha was located in the [[Karatha system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Tregillis sector/Legends|Tregillis sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a warm, sunny [[Planet/Legends|world]] with a blue-green [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]<ref name="JC8" /> beneath the yellow light of its home [[Star/Legends|sun]].<ref name="JC10" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] established the [[Eyrie Base|base]] in the towering [[Limestone/Legends|limestone]] cliffs that held a natural [[Sinkhole/Legends|sinkhole]] known as the [[Eyrie]]. It housed the base's main [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], two levels above the living quarters that bordered the sandy [[Beach/Legends|beach]] below. Early one morning, [[Water/Legends|sea]] fog had melted away from the limestone cliffs, where one of the planet's native [[Bird/Legends|birds]] of prey hunted.<ref name="JC8" />

==History==
[[File:Stevan_Makintay_SWJ10.jpg|left|thumb|250px|At the height of the Galactic Civil War, Stevan Makintay served at the Rebel base on Karatha as the leader of an X-wing squadron]]
By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] had established the [[Eyrie Base]] on the planet Karatha. Compared to the [[Echo Base/Legends|Rebel facility]] on<ref name="JC8" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], it had less food, fuel, and personnel. The [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth disaster]] further complicated the situation for the rebels on Karatha, as the Eyrie Base came to the aid of the survivors, providing what little it could spare to help the Alliance's Central Command establish a new base. As a result of the resulting supply shortages, the ground crews at the Eyrie Base were listless and tired, owing as much to their meager rations as to their crippling work schedule.<ref name="JC8" />

After suffering repeated [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] losses<ref name="ERC" /> while raiding [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Supply carrier/Legends|convoys]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Green Squadron (Eyrie Base)|squadron]] leader [[Stevan Makintay]] proposed recruiting sympathetic manufacturing experts as a way to alleviate the supply shortages on the Eyrie Base. He undertook a solo recruitment [[First mission to Hargeeva|mission]] to his homeworld, [[Hargeeva]], and returned to Karatha with the brilliant metallurgist [[Ketrian Altronel]], who joined the Rebellion. Ketrian brought with her a [[Ketrian Altronel's alloy|breakthrough alloy]] that could increase the firepower of the Rebel X-wings.<ref name="JC8" /> It soon became clear that Ketrian had been [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]], and in order to save her from the toxin, Stevan Makintay [[Second mission to Hargeeva|returned]] to Hargeeva to kidnap the Imperial [[Nial Pedrin]] and bring him to the Rebel base on Karatha.<ref name="JC10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Karatha first appeared in "[[Firepower]]," a short story written by [[Carolyn Golledge]] for the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 8|eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', which was published in [[November]] [[1995]].<ref name="JC8" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Karatha system/Legends|Karatha star system]] and the world itself in grid square L-15.<ref name="EA" />
